name: Montana Audubon Wildlife Fund Grants
summary: Small endowment-funded grants for research, education and other work that conserves wildlife and natural communities in Montana, with preference for nongame wildlife and small nonprofits. Can cover supplies, mileage and equipment.
reporting: A brief report on project status and use of funds.

status.quote: In 2026, Montana Audubon awarded 6 Audubon Wildlife Fund Grants.

deadline.quote: All proposals must be received via email no later than Friday, January 16, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Grants will be awarded to individuals or nonprofit organizations whose project directly benefits wildlife in Montana.
